units.source_text: 我们一边喝谈茶，一边品尝从未曾吃过的像是西式糕点的东西。

en.t: As we drank tea and talked, we tasted something like Western-style pastries, the sort of thing we had never eaten before.

units.source_text: 吃的时候越紧张，糕点上的粉末就越掉落在我的膝上。

en.t: The more nervous I became while eating, the more the powder from the pastries fell onto my knees.

units.source_text: 当时我是穿着光亮的黑哗叽制服。

en.t: At the time I was wearing a shiny black serge uniform.
